correctness.rationale: Reconstructed every normalization and quantifier. Strict convexity plus totally unimodular incidence constraints makes all maximizers integer; the diameter-two reduction, cross-family inequality, n=6 equality exception and exact phase comparison are proven in RESULT.md. The packaged independent standard-library enumerator reproduced all size profiles n=5,6,7 and exact integer phase inequalities through n=999; finite checks are corroboration only.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Graph spread equals inverse squared Euclidean inradius of the canonical symmetric-edge polytope divided by graph vertex count. The Petersen inradius therefore covers n=5, but its fixed ten-vertex result does not imply a formula for n>=6. Borg does not optimize the variance-penalized, disjoint level-set functional; no equivalent all-n Kneser-spread formula surfaced.
